term: powers named in the reported commissions (CommissionReport.powers)
definition: For each of the five Gospel reports of a commission given by Jesus to his disciples, the powers the report says he gave or promised: Matthew 16.18-19 (to Peter, promised): the keys of the kingdom of heaven and binding and loosing; Matthew 18.17-18 (to the disciples addressed): the ekklēsia's hearing of a member's case with exclusion of one who refuses it (judgeAsChurch), and binding and loosing; Matthew 28.18-20 (to the eleven): making disciples of all nations, baptizing, and teaching them to keep all Jesus commanded; John 20.21-23 (to the disciples gathered): forgiving and retaining sins; John 21.15-17 (to Peter): shepherding (feeding and tending) Jesus' lambs and sheep. This is textual content only: that a report names a power does not make Jesus' giving it an event (Commissioning.Gave). Recipients are not encoded.
